title: Congressional Bill S. 2398 Signed into Law
summary: On Wednesday, September 30, 2026, the President signed into law: S. 2398, the “Kay Hagan Tick Reauthorization Act,” which reauthorizes through Fiscal Year 2030, activities to address vector-borne diseases. The post Congressional Bill S. 2398 Signed into Law appeared first on The White House .
